candidates.title: Can 4D Foundation Models Remember?
candidates.why_candidate: PersistBench adds object-centric memory evaluation with omniscient 360-degree ground truth, code, data, and official visuals.

candidates.title: FAMOS: Feed-Forward 3D Articulation Modeling from Sparse Observations
candidates.why_candidate: Predicts movable parts and executable joint parameters from sparse observations with official comparisons.

candidates.title: Agile-WAM: An Agile Tactile World Action Model for Contact-Rich Robot Control
candidates.why_candidate: Efficient tactile WAM with nine simulation tasks, five real tasks, and official execution videos.

candidates.title: FunArt: Decoding Functional Structure and Articulation from Generative 3D Latents
candidates.why_candidate: Builds functional articulation-aware 3D scene graphs with joint parameters and interaction elements.

candidates.title: Astronex-World 1.0: Real-Time Interactive World Model Foundation
candidates.why_candidate: Open real-time controllable world-model family with code, weights, training recipe, and extensive demos.

candidates.title: Universal Navigation Interface: Robot-Free Data for Wheeled Robot Navigation
candidates.why_candidate: Robot-free physically constrained data interface, 37.2 km corpus, and official wheelchair demos.

candidates.title: BinoGen: Scaling egocentric binocular data for embodied visual perception and learning
candidates.why_candidate: Generates more than 20M embodiment-aware binocular images with dense labels and transfer evidence.

candidates.title: SlugTrails: An Egocentric Benchmark for Floor Plan Localization in Large Buildings
candidates.why_candidate: Released deployment-scale localization dataset, protocols, and tools.

candidates.title: Workspace Models: Lightweight Robotic Memory via Saliency-Driven Supervision
candidates.why_candidate: Strong policy-memory method with hardware results but no official execution surface.
